description: This is a Python test source file for a FastAPI/asyncio-based project. It contains test functions for user endpoints, including creating users, generating keys, fetching user info, and testing user isolation and key management. It uses pytest for asynchronous testing, aiohttp for HTTP requests, and interacts with a service running on localhost port 4000.

methods.name: new_user( session, i, user_id=None, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=None )
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new user by sending a POST request to the /user/new endpoint with specified parameters.

methods.name: generate_key( session, i, budget=None, budget_duration=None, models=["azure-models", "gpt-4", "dall-e-3"], max_parallel_requests: Optional[int] = None, user_id: Optional[str] = None, team_id: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[dict] = None, calling_key="sk-1234", )
methods.description: Generates a new API key by sending a POST request to the /key/generate endpoint with various optional parameters.

methods.name: test_user_new()
methods.description: Performs a concurrency test by creating multiple users in parallel to verify the user creation endpoint.

methods.name: get_user_info(session, get_user, call_user, view_all: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Fetches user information via GET request, optionally as an admin or specific user, returning JSON data or raising exceptions on failure.

methods.name: test_user_info()
methods.description: Tests retrieving user info as admin, self, and a random user, including validation of response structure.

methods.name: test_user_update()
methods.description: Placeholder for user update tests (not implemented).

methods.name: test_users_budgets_reset()
methods.description: Tests automatic reset of user budgets after a delay by creating users with budget constraints and checking reset timestamps.

methods.name: chat_completion(session, key, model="gpt-4")
methods.description: Uses the AsyncOpenAI client to perform a chat completion request with specified messages and model.

methods.name: chat_completion_streaming(session, key, model="gpt-4")
methods.description: Performs a streaming chat completion request, iterating over the streamed response.

methods.name: test_global_proxy_budget_update()
methods.description: Verifies that proxy budget updates are reflected after chat completions, including streaming responses.

methods.name: test_user_model_access()
methods.description: Tests model access restrictions for a user with specific models, validating allowed and disallowed models.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,Dict] setup_test_users(session: aiohttp.ClientSession)
methods.description: Sets up two test users and an additional key for the first user, returning user info and headers.

methods.name: None print_response_details(response: aiohttp.ClientResponse)
methods.description: Utility to print detailed HTTP response status and JSON content.

methods.name: test_key_update_user_isolation()
methods.description: Tests that users cannot update keys belonging to other users, expecting a 403 response.

methods.name: test_key_delete_user_isolation()
methods.description: Tests that users cannot delete keys belonging to other users, expecting a 403 response.
